claims.claim_vi: Use cases the source gives: List keeps Twitter feeds; Stack supports undo/redo of a word editor; Queue keeps printer jobs or sends user actions in a game; Hash Table for caching systems; Array for math operations; Heap for task scheduling; Tree keeps the HTML document or serves AI decisions; Suffix Tree searches strings in a document; Graph tracks friendship or path finding; R-Tree finds the nearest neighbor; Vertex Buffer sends data to the GPU for rendering.
